in_marathi.name: Madhusoodan
in_marathi.long_meaning: Madhusoodan हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The one who crushes the evil and protects the good, symbolizing love and power. In Hindu mythology, Madhusoodan is a form of Lord Vishnu, who is often depicted with a sweetmeat (Madhu) in his hand.

In Hindu mythology, Madhusoodan is a form of Lord Vishnu, who is often depicted with a sweetmeat (Madhu) in his hand.
